title: Army Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit confirmed to Steinman

tellings.quote: Yeah, 47 to 50. And I that was first confirmed in 1986 to UFO researcher William Steinman.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit, which he describes as a US Army group that dealt with UFO matters from 1947 to 1950. He says its existence was first confirmed in 1986 to a UFO researcher named William Steinman, and he points to a report and a field order from the unit. If true, it would mean the Army ran its own early UFO effort.
